meta.name: Indian Police Force
meta.description:
Follows the harrowing journey of Delhi Police Officer Kabir Malik as he battles an insidious adversary, Zarar, who has chosen the path of terrorism.

Rated A · Ended · First aired 19 Jan 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Reliance Entertainment, Rohit Shetty Productionz · Network: Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Delhi Police Raising Day
videos.overview: In the heart of India's bustling capital - Delhi, chaos erupts as a series of deadly blasts rock the city. Panic and fear grip the residents as the blasts seem relentless, leaving behind a trail of destruction. The city's peace is shattered, and the responsibility to catch the perpetrators falls upon the brave men and women of Delhi Police.

videos.title: One Wrong Call
videos.overview: Aided by Gujarat ATS chief Tara Shetty, Kabir and Vikram analyse evidence but their frustration continues as their investigation gets riddled with dead ends. An unexpected turn of events unfolds and a phone call from the terrorist's hideout gives a clue that may help Delhi Police track down their location.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: After a relentless pursuit, Kabir and Vikram finally locate the terrorists' hideout. In a heart-pounding ambush, Delhi Police confront the terrorists in a fierce gunfight, resulting in casualties on both sides.

videos.title: The Ghost Is Back
videos.overview: Zarar is on a sinister mission once again to execute bombings in the city of Jaipur. He succeeds in carrying out these deadly acts. As Kabir learns about the explosions, he jumps into conducting an illegal inquiry of his own in Jaipur.

videos.title: The Loss
videos.overview: As Kabir and team conduct their investigations in Goa, they get a breakthrough. Meanwhile, Zarar and his brother Sikku prepare to unleash chaos upon the city, setting the stage for a showdown. A tragic accident unfolds. As the episode comes to a close, the information regarding Nafeesa's mother shocks the Police force and advances the inquiry towards learning the truth about Zarar's intentions.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Kabir reaches Darbhanga and confronts Nafisa about Zarar's true identity. Shocked by this revelation, Nafeesa faints and Kabir takes her to the hospital. Realising Zarar’s truth, Nafeesa surrenders to the police and discloses that Zarar was in Bangladesh. Kabir along with Tara Shetty head to Delhi to seek permission from the Home Minister for a cross border operation to bring Zarar back.

videos.title: Home Coming
videos.overview: Kabir travels to Bangladesh to find Zarar after receiving approval from the Home Minister. With the assistance of Jagtap and Rana, and a spectacular series of events in the pursuit of Zarar, Kabir ultimately succeeds in bringing back India's most wanted terrorist to his soil.
